svg.title: Administration and security: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#242)
svg.desc: The administration and security epic as a map: accounts, teams, signing in and the instance, with the audit log under all of them and three pieces beside, who sees what between a site admin, a team admin and a finance admin, and the order the pieces land in.
svg.text: Administration and security: how the pieces fit
· accounts in bulk, an audit log, SSO and instance settings

g.text: four places, the log under them, and three beside
Made for people, before they arrive.
With no password, and a link to choose one.
Who may make one, and what exists.
Anyone, site admins, or named people.
Sizes, dates and names. No tickets.
In the app. The environment wins.
Who did what, to what, when and from where. Everything above
From any tool that exports one.
the IT role, and what it is not

svg.text: The site admin is the IT role. Nothing here lets a site admin read a team’s tickets or anybody’s pay.
early: everything else is something it should record
The guards that exist stay: nobody deactivates or demotes themselves, and the last active site admin cannot be switched off. An environment variable wins over a setting in the
database. Nothing leaves the instance. SCIM stays where the roadmap put it. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #302 to #315.
